acceptance.new_correct: Must compare the fresh paired control, not historical or synthetic saved-candidate runs.
acceptance.substep_success: Compile/interface improvements alone never count as complete answer success.

stop.run_failure: Stop remaining generation, do not launch treatment if control fails.

non_changes: H and R0.6 gates, rolling parent seed48
limitations: Exposed development selection only, not H/generalization.
One sample per case/condition cannot establish stable causality.
Direct sampling may fluctuate despite identical inputs; record all reversals.
Even passing permits only discussion of another authorized confirmation, not default adoption.

synthetic_example.source: Actual AST-extracted model-visible DDL and Forge JSON
synthetic_example.oracles: Raw-row Python Counter/set and independently authored SQLite SQL
limitations: SQLite only; no other dialect behavior established.
assure_compiled_sql covers SQL safety/parse/registry binding, not the full assure_query intent/policy pipeline.
Negative compiled SQL is also executed directly only on ephemeral synthetic SQLite to independently observe unresolved names after assurance rejects it.
Synthetic fixtures demonstrate the stated cases, not all possible CTE or alias semantics.

saved_candidate_regression.purpose: Saved Sol pipeline proof, not new Luna generation or an accuracy gain

fixture_adjustments.reason: Uvicorn re-raises its termination signal after shutdown, so atexit-only network receipt did not persist. Initialized and synchronously updated the backend guard receipt; no production code changes.
fixture_adjustments.first_attempt_status: Transport checks passed, backend zero-attempt evidence missing; rerun required for complete receipt.

fixture_adjustments.reason: The two arms run concurrently; changed wire-response hash recording from the latest global prompt entry to the originating per-session entry and assert Forge-only ownership. Candidate outputs and existing saved response/instruction hashes were already exact.
